Evidence & scope

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

posttrain-arena · access terms: PostTrain Arena records declared task author, license and original/adapted/generated origin fields and pins submitted content to a repository commit; its README applies AGPL 3.0 to repository contents unless otherwise noted and describes draft CC BY 4.0 data/text and Apache 2.0 code submission rules.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.posttrain.credit-and-license.v2

  • Contributor metadata is declared rather than independently verified; missing or invalid license/origin causes a warning rather than a structural block. Draft submission terms require checking the final rules.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

posttrain-arena · documents: The captured PostTrain landing page accepts contributions while challenge runs are paused pending evaluation repairs/base-model measurement. The later README separates public configuration and bounded historical pipeline checks from proof that a full held-out training run completed.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.posttrain.demonstration-limits.v2

  • Seen-task historical practice and a small same-domain diagnostic are not evidence of broad held-out generalization; illustrative landing-page scoreboards are not measured results.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

posttrain-arena · evaluates: PostTrain Arena’s organizer specification fixes the model, training recipe and held-out suite for a challenge and ranks contributed environment collections by the change in held-out pass@1 after versus before training in the same run.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.posttrain.fixed-comparison.v2

  • An organizer reviews a result before ranking; the landing page ranks collections by mean change over accepted runs and warns that a small change from one noisy run is not evidence of improvement.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

posttrain-arena · has stage: PostTrain Arena documents static overlap/leakage checks and planned dynamic reference/no-op/difficulty controls; static acceptance reads source without executing it and is explicitly not proof that the oracle, runtime or verifier works.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.posttrain.quality-gates.v2

  • The planned dynamic checks rerun reference and no-op controls eight times and target one to three base-model successes in four attempts. The specification says runs do not yet wait for these verdicts.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

posttrain-arena · benchmark task: PostTrain Arena accepts collections of one to two hundred task packages containing a prompt/limits file, Docker environment, verifier and reference oracle; verifiers run only after the agent finishes and must score substantive output rather than file existence.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.posttrain.task-contract.v2

  • The documented held-out attempt passes only if its verifier passes, and a time-limit attempt fails. This package contract does not establish that every submitted task’s verifier works.
